2608.28399.title: RetailAgent: Structured Adverse Timing in Self-Conditioned Multimodal LLM Trading Agents
2608.28399.paper_summary: In financial markets, a sequential policy that reacts systematically to price movements may become predictable to other market participants. This paper studies whether large language model (LLM) agents exhibit such directional structure through RetailAgent, an experimental framework in which an LLM observes anonymized intraday equity price histories and permitted state, then repeatedly chooses long (hold the stock) or flat (stay out) before the subsequent interval return is revealed. We compare returns during long and flat intervals along the same stock's intraday path after removing the overall fraction of long decisions. This exposure-matched measure reveals persistent negative timing across modality, horizon, state, and model family. Shuffling saved action sequences substantially attenuates the effect, showing that alignment between actions and subsequent returns drives the negative score. Feeding self-authored memories into decisions further increases policy persistence, while timing becomes more negative among stock-days on which the agent uses both actions. These results reveal stable, recoverable directional structure in sequential LLM financial decisions and a behavioral signal for studying how another participant could respond to a predictable policy.
2608.28399.paper_summary_zh: 在金融市場中，對價格變動系統性反應的順序政策可能會對其他市場參與者變得可預測。本文研究大型語言模型（LLM）代理是否通過RetailAgent顯示出這種方向性結構，這是一個實驗框架，LLM觀察匿名的日內股票價格歷史和允許的狀態，然後在隨後的區間回報揭示之前，反覆選擇做多（持有股票）或平倉（不進場）。我們比較在去除整體長期決策比例後，同一股票日內路徑上長期和平倉區間的回報。這種曝光匹配的衡量顯示出在模式、時間範圍、狀態和模型家族之間持續存在的負時間效應。隨機打亂保存的行動序列顯著減弱了這種效果，顯示出行動與隨後回報之間的對齊驅動了負分數。將自我創作的記憶納入決策進一步增加了政策的持續性，而在代理使用兩種行動的股票日中，時間效應變得更加負面。這些結果揭示了順序LLM金融決策中的穩定、可恢復的方向性結構，以及研究另一參與者如何應對可預測政策的行為信號。
